name: Infinity Horizon
summary: Online play for Forza Horizon 2 on SteamOS: the Infinity launcher, through Proton.
description:
Infinity Horizon brings Forza Horizon 2's online services back: an account, cloud saves, free roam and online races with other players. Its launcher signs you in, finds your Azimuth copy of the game and starts it online.

Install Forza Horizon 2 (Azimuth) from piShop first, then open Infinity Horizon from Steam. It finds the game installed by that recipe by itself; at the first start, install the Infinity hook when the launcher asks.

The launcher updates itself; Check for updates here does the same.
steamos: Needs Proton 11.0 or Proton Experimental, which bring the Steam Linux Runtime 4.0 (Steam → Library → Tools).
Start the game from Infinity Horizon, not from the Forza Horizon 2 shortcut, to play online.

parts.name: Infinity Horizon
